performance_case.causal_mechanism: Weekly regulator-aggregated CME Bitcoin trader positioning could describe a slow institutional risk state distinct from spot price, spot microstructure, carry and post-shock labels, but it is testable only after an exact point-in-time source package prevents observation-date, release-date and same-cycle leakage.
performance_case.claim_boundary: A positive result proves only that an inactive offline CFTC TFF source contract, schemas, validator and synthetic fixtures satisfy their frozen local checks. It does not prove endpoint availability, actual row presence, predictive value, factor direction, PnL, drawdown, deployment, canonical registration, OOS authority or any Trading action.
performance_case.drawdown_hypothesis: Immediate drawdown effect is zero. Any future reduction in adverse exposure remains MISSING_PROOF until a separately preregistered field interpretation passes forward predictive breadth, equal-capital fee-adjusted PnL and drawdown-path gates.
performance_case.opportunity_cost: The five-file slice consumes local engineering time but avoids continuous-feed cost and repeated source ambiguity. It must close if exact release, identity or hash-chain semantics cannot be encoded without operational capture, because that would divert capacity from the active 90-day and 14-day forward lanes.
performance_case.performance_hypothesis: This implementation has zero immediate fee-adjusted PnL effect. Its capability value is to make one low-cost, causally distinct public source deterministic and falsifiable so a later pre-outcome task can select or reject one factor without redoing provenance, clock and integrity work.
